study.title: Vision-Language Semantic Grounding for Multi-Domain Crop-Weed Segmentation

segmentation.domain: Crop/weed/background (3-class) semantic segmentation of multi-domain agricultural imagery (novel UAV soybean + public PhenoBench UAV sugar beet + GrowingSoy ground 4K + ROSE robotic maize/bean) for targeted herbicide application; vision-language grounding to overcome negative transfer / label heterogeneity in multi-dataset training; domain adaptation with limited target-domain supervision (10/20/50/100% labeled target data)
models_tested: VL-WS (proposed): DeepLabv3+ ResNet-101 spatial encoder + frozen CLIP image embeddings + FiLM caption-conditioned modulation
segmentation.best_model: VL-WS: frozen CLIP global embeddings fused with DeepLabv3+ (ResNet-101) dense spatial features, modulated via FiLM conditioned on GPT-4o-mini-generated agronomy-aware captions (CLIP text encoder last-2-layer fine-tuned); aggregated mean Dice 91.64% vs best CNN baseline DeepLabv3+ 86.66% (+4.98%); weed Dice 80.45% vs DeepLabv3+ 65.03% (+15.42%); U-Net 85.58%, PSPNet 85.19%. Dataset-wise weed Dice: UAV Soybean 80.40, PhenoBench 77.57, GrowingSoy 86.09, ROSE 75.66 (smallest cross-domain variance of all models)

dataset.name: Multi-domain corpus = novel UAV Soybean-VL (author-collected) + 3 public benchmarks (PhenoBench, GrowingSoy, ROSE). UAV Soybean-VL: soybean field, Emile A. Lods Agronomy Research Centre, McGill University, Sainte-Anne-de-Bellevue, QC, Canada; DJI Mavic 3 Multispectral RGB at 5 m altitude, GSD 1.4 mm/px, plot 88 m x 18 m; georeferenced orthomosaic tiled into 7606 tiles of 512x512 px (25% overlap); >50% non-informative tiles discarded; 293 tiles manually annotated (LabelMe) into background (soil), crop (soybean), weed.
dataset.note: images = annotated UAV Soybean-VL tiles (262 train + 30 validation). Full corpus composition: PhenoBench (public, 2872 RGB tiles 1024x1024, UAV at 21 m ~1 mm/px sugar beet, 1407 train/772 val + hidden test, ~129000 unlabeled), GrowingSoy (public, 1000 annotated 640x640 images from 4K videos, soybean, ground ATV platform, Brazil), ROSE (public, bean/maize subset 250 bean images, 4 robot platforms). Aggregated weed class spans ~12-14 distinct weed species. Primary metric Dice (%); aggregate Table 1 = mean 91.64% (weed 80.45 / crop 95.23 / bg 99.24).

segmentation.backbone: Dual-encoder design: (1) task-specific spatial encoder = DeepLabv3+ with ResNet-101 backbone configured to output stride 8 via atrous conv (effective dilation 2/4 in final residual blocks) + ASPP module (parallel atrous convs dilations 12/24/36, 1x1 branch, image-level GAP branch); (2) frozen CLIP image encoder (input resized 224x224, 512-dim global embedding projected to 256) providing domain-invariant semantics. CLIP text encoder (last 2 of 12 transformer layers fine-tuned) encodes captions -> FiLM gamma/beta (scale/shift) modulation over the channel-wise concatenation of ASPP features (256 ch) + broadcast CLIP visual embedding (256 ch) = 512 ch fused map. Decoder: bilinear x2 upsample + 48-ch low-level feature concat (304 ch), two 3x3 convs to 256, 1x1 conv -> 3-class logits. Loss = 0.6*Dice + 0.4*weighted CE + 0.02*symmetric InfoNCE vision-language contrastive (temperature 0.07)

mIoU.ambiguity: mIoU not reported; the paper's primary metric is class-wise Dice averaged over classes (Dice computed globally per class then averaged).

F1.ambiguity: F1 not reported; Dice coefficient (equivalent to class F1 in formula) used instead - reported under the Dice field.

Dice.quote: VL-WS achieves a mean Dice score of 91.64% ... outperforming the strongest Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) baseline by 4.98%
Dice.ambiguity: Aggregated mean Dice across the multi-domain test set (arXiv preprint). Class-wise: weed 80.45, crop 95.23, background 99.24. Dataset-wise (Table 2) VL-WS: UAV Soybean 80.40/98.21/96.47; PhenoBench 77.57/95.84/99.49; GrowingSoy 86.09/92.98/98.66; ROSE 75.66/92.49/97.30 (weed/crop/bg). Reported in percent in the paper; stored as fraction.

weed_F1.ambiguity: Weed-class metric reported as DICE (80.45% aggregated), not F1 - recorded in the Dice field ambiguity note. The 65.03% DeepLabv3+ weed Dice is the strongest CNN baseline; weeds are the discriminating class (crop/bg near-saturated).

crop_F1.ambiguity: Crop-class metric reported as Dice 95.23% (aggregated), not F1.

edge.device: Desktop workstation: NVIDIA RTX 3080 GPU (10 GB); no embedded/edge deployment
edge.framework: PyTorch (PyTorch Lightning); AdamW optimizer LR 3e-5 (visual encoder) / 3e-6 (text encoder), cosine annealing to 1e-7, 200 epochs, batch size 8, early stopping patience 30; input images resized to 512x512

issues: Multi-dataset benchmark (UAV soybean + UAV sugar beet PhenoBench + ground 4K GrowingSoy + robotic ROSE); the aggregated results mix aerial and ground-platform imagery, and PhenoBench's ~1 mm/px GSD/21 m UAV claim mirrors that dataset's public documentation.

Primary metric is Dice (%); mIoU/IoU NOT reported as the headline. IoU figures cited in comparisons (PhenoBench weed IoU 63.35%, ROSE 60.84%) are the AUTHORS' OWN DICE->IoU CONVERSIONS of VL-WS results, not directly reported IoU metrics.
edge.reported=false: everything on a desktop RTX 3080; no latency/FPS/power/params/FLOPs anywhere.
Crop (95.23%) and background (99.24%) Dice near-saturated; the meaningful gain is on weeds: weed Dice 80.45% vs DeepLabv3+ 65.03% (+15.42%); smaller cross-dataset variance than all CNNs.

Novel UAV Soybean-VL dataset: 293 annotated 512x512 tiles (262 train/30 val) @ 5 m, GSD 1.4 mm/px; revised split merges the prior test set into training and rebuilds validation around high weed density.

Domain adaptation (Table 3): VL-WS trained on 3 source datasets + 10/20/50/100% of target labels; e.g., UAV Soybean target weed Dice 68.63 (10%) to 80.40 (100%) - data-efficient under limited supervision. Ablation (Table 4): best contrastive loss weight lambda_VL = 0.02. Data available on request.
